decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 30 November 2005 the use of the rear room of the premises as a coffee shop is permitted under the General Permitted Development (Amendment) Order 2005 for the following reason:
The existing and proposed use fall with the same Use Class (A1) in the Use Classes (Amendment) Order 2005.   
Condition : 2 - Informatives : 
	
1. This Certificate is not for A3 (Restaurants, snack bars and cafes), A4 (pubs 	and bars) or A5 (take-aways). The existing use for the premises entitles you to use it as a sandwich bar or similar use which would compose of:

Sale of sandwiches or other cold food for consumption off the premises.

You should note that a sandwich bar does not necessarily cease to be in the shops class merely because, for example, it also sells a very small amount of hot drinks, hot soup or food that is heated up. Similarly, it is possible for a few sandwich bar customers to eat on the premises, including at tables, without a material change of use. Provided that this is only an ancillary part of the business the use would remain as A1: Shops use class where the retail sales element is the primary purpose.
Condition : 3 - 2.  As the proposal involves the preparation of food you will be required to comply with environmental health standards. Please contact the Food Safety Team on 020 8583 5555.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the use of the rear room of the premises as a coffee shop.
